description: Portable and Travel-Friendly Design Designed for maximum portability, the Portronics CoolCube is compact, lightweight, and comes with a foldable handle, making it easy to carry and perfect for desktops, workstations, or travel. Long-Lasting 2400mAh Battery Enjoy up to 3 hours of cordless operation with the built-in 2400mAh rechargeable battery. Great for use during power cuts or outdoor setups where plugs aren't accessible. Fast Type-C Charging Equipped with a modern Type-C charging port, the CoolCube offers fast and reliable recharging, reducing downtime between uses and ensuring efficient power delivery. 360° Adjustable Airflow The unique 360-degree rotatable fan design allows you to direct the breeze wherever you need it. Easily tilt and swivel to stay cool from any angle. Powerful 3-Speed Modes Customize your cooling with three fan speed levels – 1800, 2100, and 2500 RPM – offering soft breeze to strong airflow depending on your preference and environment. BLDC Motor for Quiet Operation Powered by a brushless DC motor, the fan ensures energy efficiency and ultra-quiet performance, making it ideal for use while sleeping, working, or studying. Stylish and Minimalist Aesthetic With a clean, modern look in white, this desktop fan blends seamlessly into home and office décor while delivering high-performance cooling.
